messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: You should not use buspirone if you are allergic to it.
Do not use buspirone if you have taken an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days. A dangerous drug interaction could occur. MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue injection, phenelzine, rasagiline, selegiline, and tranylcypromine.
To make sure this medicine is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have any of these conditions:
- kidney disease; or
- liver disease.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. This medicine should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.
It is not known whether buspirone passes into breast milk. You should avoid breast-feeding while using this medicine.
Buspirone is not FDA-approved for use by anyone younger than 18 years old, but this medicine has been used in children and adolescents under close medical supervision and at the appropriate dosage.
Triplet: ["buspirone", "has interaction warning", "dangerous drug interaction"]

The relation 'has interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause a dangerous drug interaction with the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
